title: RTP Edit for RPG Maker MZ - Luscious Overworld

posts.author: JardsonJean
posts.body:
Hi, guys!
My name is JardsonJean and I'm from Brazil. You might know me from other resources online, mostly maps.
I'm the one behind the LadyLuck page on itch.io
(Check Here!)
I love using RPG Maker to create overworld maps and just recently I got MZ. The default tileset felt a little empty and I decided to go all in and make additions to make world maps look luscious and detailed while still using elements from the RTP, which is a very commom practice. I've been working on these for about 3 weeks, but my notebook is not working the best at the moment so I had to stop. In any case, I wanted to share these for feedback and to see what you guys can do with it too.
You can use these as much as you please as long as you're using RPG Maker MZ and, although I plan to update this in the future, it'll always be free (obviously). No need to credit, just don't share claiming as your work. BTW, feel free to break it apart recolor and do anything else you want to make it fit your project.
A few disclaimers before you move on:
I'm not exactly sure how practical this could be for an actual world map running in-game, I never got to finish a whole project for myself and I aware that actual World Maps tend to be much simpler.
To expand the tileset in this way I completely ditched the sci-fi elements on tab C.
At this point, I'd love to give you guys a full rundown of my map making process, but as I said before my notebook is giving problems and I'm not able to record anything on it (it's an old warrior).
Not everything is change on all tilesets, I wanted to separate them but since I used them as is, I decided to keep them in.]
If you want to support me, just visit my page for more resources. Make sure to drop a comment, like or donation. Thank you.
